name: visual-companions
description: Draws agent ```viz blocks as compact visuals, keeps the latest headline above the prompt, /catchup shows recent ones. Costs the model ~400 cached prompt tokens + ~80 per visual.

visuals.title: Visuals
visuals.description: Ask the agent for viz blocks. Off removes the ~400-token guide from the system prompt, so no new visuals are drawn.

band.title: Headline band
band.description: Show the latest visual's headline (and Boo) above the prompt.

activity.title: Activity line
activity.description: While the agent works, show its goal, task and current step in the band. Off also skips the small Haiku call that names a plain prompt's goal.

history.title: History size
history.description: How many visuals /catchup keeps per session.

retention.title: History retention (days)
retention.description: Other sessions' visual history is deleted after this many days.

companion.title: Companion
companion.description: Boo beside the headline above the prompt: small (one row of braille), big (two rows of pixels), or off (a glyph only).

booAnimation.title: Boo animation
booAnimation.description: animated, or still: one resting pose per mood, with no timer.

booReactions.title: Boo reactions
booReactions.description: Play the one-shot reactions: the cheer on green, the fade on red, the relief hop. Off goes straight to the resting loop.

booEffects.title: Boo effects
booEffects.description: Small Boo's particles and glow: sparkles, rain, the working trail.

booColor.title: Boo colour
booColor.description: mood (a colour per outcome), mono (one neutral colour), or claude (Claude orange).
